<p>The new year arrived, and with it, the season for field training had finally come.</p><p>The Association must have gotten a handle on the recent surge in Gate numbers, because they announced they’d be supplementing the field training instructors.</p><p>Since the training involved entering E-rank Gates in teams of five, taking all 30 trainees from my class would require no less than six separate trips. But it looked like I might not have to do all of them.</p><p>“Then how many times do I need to go in?”</p><p>“Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon, you don’t need to participate in the field training.”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>“Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon, the Association President has just assigned you a new request.”</p><p>I was caught off guard—I hadn’t heard anything about this from my supervisor.</p><p>“But I haven’t been told anything by my supervisor…”</p><p>“Ah… we just got the call ourselves.”</p><p>Vvvring—</p><p>Speak of the devil. My phone buzzed with a call from my supervisor.</p><p>“Actually, my supervisor’s calling me right now.”</p><p>“You can ask them about the request details.”</p><p>“Right…”</p><p>‘Well, the Association wouldn’t just send extra instructors to the training center for no reason…’</p><p>It seemed like there were separate requests meant for Hunters like me or Min Se-rin who were currently working as instructors at the academy. They were probably filling in with temporary B-rank instructors so they could pull us out for a bit.</p><p>“Hello?”</p><p>“Yes, Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon, how have you been?”</p><p>“Uh… I just heard there’s a new request, and I might have to leave the training center for a bit…”</p><p>“Ah, so you’ve already heard. I just got the notice myself. This request came directly from the President, so it’s hard to refuse, but if you don’t want to do it, I can try talking to them.”</p><p>“Well… let’s hear the details first.”</p><p>This time, I actually felt bad for my supervisor.</p><p>It was a direct order from the President—refusing wasn’t an option. And yet, they were still willing to put in a word for me if I didn’t want to do it. That kind of consideration made me feel better.</p><p>‘Yeah… if they’re this polite about it, we can get along just fine.’</p><p>“The President is heading to Japan to discuss Tsushima with the Japanese Hunter Association President, and… uh…”</p><p>My supervisor hesitated, as if something was off.</p><p>“Suddenly, they decided to swap out a few of the Hunters assigned to the President’s security detail. And you, Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon, are one of the replacements…”</p><p>“What? Why me…?”</p><p>“Well… you do have experience with security at the hotel…”</p><p>“But why change the security team in the first place? Was there a problem?”</p><p>“No, nothing like that. I don’t have all the details, but from what I’ve heard, some A-rank Hunters who were supposed to handle security got pulled into another critical mission, so they had to fill the spots with other A-ranks.”</p><p>“Hmm…”</p><p>At least it wasn’t some shady business like the last time, when someone tried to assassinate the Association President.</p><p>‘Well, the President himself is an S-rank Hunter—could an assassination even be possible?’</p><p>I hadn’t seen the President since my sparring match with Min Se-rin, so I’d assumed he might have forgotten about me. But the fact that he still remembered left me uneasy.</p><p>‘Wait… does this mean I’ve been officially branded as part of Kang Hye-na’s faction?’</p><p>The second thing that bothered me was the President mentioning he was going to Japan to discuss Tsushima Island—Daemado.</p><p>Tsushima Island and Daemado were currently uninhabitable hellscapes overrun by monsters.</p><p>When the Gate incidents first erupted, the world was thrown into chaos. The so-called developed nations with advanced administrative systems managed to stabilize the situation relatively quickly, but many underdeveloped countries with poor infrastructure were left in ruins.</p><p>The three East Asian nations—Korea, China, and Japan—moved swiftly to contain the crisis and established their respective Hunter Associations. However, Japan’s situation was a bit different.</p><p>In the early stages of the crisis, an abnormally high number of Gates appeared in Japan compared to its land area, far exceeding the numbers in Korea and China.</p><p>Japan’s Hunter Association already held significant authority, but to handle the disaster of mass Gate outbreaks, the cabinet granted the Association even more power.</p><p>Somehow, they managed to stabilize the mainland, and over time, the number of Gates decreased. But Daemado was a different story.</p><p>With all their focus on the mainland, the government had no resources left to spare for Daemado. In the end, the cabinet made the difficult decision to abandon the island.</p><p>Daemado was undeniably strange. Despite being less than half the size of Jeju Island, it had over ten times as many Gates.</p><p>Preoccupied with stabilizing the mainland, the government kept delaying the Daemado Gate suppression operations. As the situation worsened, they eventually gave up on the island entirely.</p><p>After that, Daemado truly became a monster-infested wasteland.</p><p>Of course, once Japan’s Gate anomalies were under control, the government began sending Hunters to Daemado to reduce the number of Gates. But after years of neglect, the island was already overrun with monsters that had poured out from the Gates.</p><p>Recently, I’d seen posts in Hunter communities and news articles claiming that the Japanese government had managed to stabilize Daemado to some extent and was preparing for a final push.</p><p>Recapturing Daemado was a long-standing goal of the Japanese Hunter Association, so many speculated that a large-scale Hunter force would be deployed.</p><p>‘But why is the President going there in person to talk…?’</p><p>I didn’t know the exact details, but it was clear that either there was something inside Daemado that the Korean Association wanted, or they were planning to involve Korean Hunters in the Daemado suppression operation to gain leverage in negotiations with Japan.</p><p>‘Well… it’s not like I’m going into Daemado myself. It’s just a security detail.’</p><p>“How long… will it take?”</p><p>“From what I’ve been told, it’ll be a 10-day trip. You’ll be on security duty every other day. I’ll send you the details via email. Oh, and the pay is 800 million won.”</p><p>‘They’re talking about the Demon Island, and now they say I’ll be in Japan for ten days?’</p><p>It was already suspicious. But if this was truly a top-secret mission, someone at the manager’s level wouldn’t know the details.</p><p>“Hunter-nim… This is just my guess, but… if it’s a ten-day trip, the personnel the Association President prepared in advance will probably enter Demon Island…”</p><p>“Enter there?”</p><p>“Well, we need to check the island’s condition in advance, so they’ll likely go as a reconnaissance mission. You’re just going as security, so there’s no need to worry.”</p><p>“Ah… I see. Then please send the email right away…”</p><p>“Yes, thank you.”</p><p>After ending the call with the manager, I immediately dialed another number.</p><p>“Huh? Hello?”</p><p>“Hye-na…”</p><p>“Yeah.”</p><p>“Was it you?”</p><p>“What about me, all of a sudden?”</p><p>“You’re the one who picked me for this security detail… or at least recommended me, right?”</p><p>If something like this happened out of the blue, there was only one person I’d suspect.</p><p>“I didn’t go as far as recommending you… but I did bring up your name. The other team members were the ones who actually recommended you.”</p><p>“Other people?”</p><p>“Yeah, Seung-jun and Se-rin did.”</p><p>“Huh…”</p><p>Now that I thought about it, Seung-jun and Se-rin were no longer just acquaintances to me.</p><p>Especially Se-rin…</p><p>If they had planned to include me in the Demon Island exploration team, they would’ve called me much earlier for training or a heads-up. So my role was probably just simple security.</p><p>And the offer of 800 million won for five days of work over ten days in Japan had already swayed my mind toward going.</p><p>‘Technically, it’s five days of work… so that’s 160 million per day…’</p><p>I was even grateful to whoever had recommended me.</p><p>At this rate, I might be able to move soon.</p><p>“Well… it’s obvious you’re going into Demon Island, Hye-na.”</p><p>“Into Demon Island? What are you talking about?”</p><p>“You’re still terrible at lying.”</p><p>“Ah, stop. If you keep talking about that, are you gonna drag me in there too?”</p><p>“Sorry… but can you do me one favor?”</p><p>“Here we go, another favor.”</p><p>“It’s nothing big. I just want Yoon Na-hyeon from the Central Headquarters to come with us on this Japan trip…”</p><p>“Ugh… fine. I’ll pass it along. But Japan isn’t a vacation, it’s a mission, you know?”</p><p>“Well, we’ve got five days off anyway. Noona—no, make sure Na-hyeon’s schedule matches mine exactly.”</p><p>“Got it. See you then.”</p><p>“Yeah, thanks.”</p><p>The call with Hye-na ended. Since I had to go to Japan anyway, I suggested combining it with a family trip abroad, and fortunately, it looked like it would work out.</p><p>‘A-rank Hunters have way more power than I thought.’</p><p>Judging by how this absurd request was accepted, the treatment for A-rank Hunters was clearly different from B-rank.</p><p>I’d been wanting to take a family trip before Ji-hyeon started university, and Japan seemed like the perfect destination.</p><p>‘But will everyone have time?’</p><p>***</p><p>“Yes, yes! Absolutely!”</p><p>My worries were unfounded—Ji-hyeon already looked thrilled.</p><p>“Mmm… I like it too, but what about Na-hyeon…?”</p><p>“I called her, and she said it’s fine.”</p><p>After finishing the call with Hye-na, I’d also called Na-hyeon.</p><p>At first, I was a little worried since I’d decided everything on my own, but she’d actually thanked me and seemed overjoyed. It wasn’t so much the excitement of going to Japan as it was the fact that many employees had wanted to join this trip, but as a rookie, she’d never dreamed she’d get the chance.</p><p>“But when are we going?”</p><p>“In two weeks. Book separate flights for you and Ji-hyeon, and get a nice hotel. The Association’s covering the cost, so just send me the prices.”</p><p>“Really? But we’re just going on a personal trip, and they’re paying?”</p><p>“We’re an A-rank Hunter’s family.”</p><p>“Oppa… you’re seriously amazing…”</p><p>Yu-na and Ji-hyeon stared at me with admiration in their eyes.</p><p>Truth be told, it was a lie. The Association would cover costs for Na-hyeon and me since we were members, but there was no way they’d pay for Yu-na and Ji-hyeon. I’d lied on purpose because if I said I was paying, Yu-na might book a cheaper place.</p><p>*** </p><p>“Haa…”</p><p>Before bed, after finishing my shower and drying off, I headed back to my room.</p><p>Even though I’d suddenly decided on the trip, my family had readily agreed, which put me in a good mood.</p><p>Squeak—</p><p>“…”</p><p>When I opened the door, two stunning beauties were lying on the bed, waiting for me.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290866" loading="lazy"></p><p>“Honey…”</p><p>“Oppa…”</p><p>Nightly sex was routine, but this was the first time both of them had been waiting for me like this.</p><p>“You two want to do it together tonight…?”</p><p>“Mmm… do you not want to, honey?”</p><p>“No.”</p><p>Well, if we’re doing it, we’re doing it.</p>
